statement: In frame 46, Person B is in a low crouch with knees bent on the image-right side of Person A, beside Person A's extended feet, with the hand nearer the image-right supporting the body on the Dirt Road.

entities.name: Person A
entities.description: Barefoot person seated left of center, with long light-colored hair, a beige patterned top, and a long white skirt.

entities.name: Person B
entities.description: Person with short dark hair, a light-blue collared shirt, and brown trousers, crouching to Person A's image-right.

statement: From frames 18 to 30, Person A continues turning the multi-button steering wheel counterclockwise past the nearly centered position, with the right grip rising and the left grip lowering.

entities.name: Person A
entities.description: Driver in the cockpit; only dark-blue-gloved hands and parts of the forearms are visible.

statement: From frames 0 to 14, Person A descends from a posture with both feet off the ground and both arms spread to the sides; by the final segment, one foot lands on the stone surface, the other leg is bent upward, and the arms gradually draw toward the sides of the body.

entities.name: Person A
entities.description: Hooded figure carrying a round shield and longbow, with a dark brown top and a long yellow-ochre waist cloth.

statement: At frame 38, Person F's body is above the near end of the concrete median barrier, with the head higher than the surrounding vehicle roofs; Person H sits sideways at the barrier on Person F's image-left lower side and is partially occluded by Person F; Vehicle D is on the image-left side of the barrier, light-colored cars in the queue of vehicles in traffic congestion are on the other side, and the distant trees are on the right side of the image.

entities.name: Person F
entities.description: Man in a white shirt, red tie, and black trousers, moving toward the concrete median barrier.

entities.name: Person H
entities.description: Woman with long dark hair and a purple sleeveless top, seated sideways on the median barrier.

entities.name: Vehicle D
entities.description: Light grayish-white sedan behind Person F at the start; later at the lower left of the image.

statement: From frames 20 to 28, Person A rotates and widens the light brown paper in hand horizontally, causing a larger area of the brown paper surface to face the camera and unfold between Person A and Person B.

entities.name: Person A
entities.description: Person on the image-right in a brown furry hat, glasses, and khaki clothes, carrying a camping backpack.

entities.name: Person B
entities.description: Person on the image-left in a light pink dress and white stockings, with reddish-brown hair tied half-up.

statement: From frames 51 to 58, the camera continues rolling clockwise while maintaining a diagonally downward view of the teal stadium seating; in the image, the near edge of the green stadium turf changes from sloping down toward the right to sloping up toward the right.
